rule: Each player has 5 cards in front of them numbered 1 to 5. The players take turns removing one card from the other player's row until only one card remains in front of each player. If the sum of the two remaining numbers is odd, the player with the larger number wins; if the sum is even, the player with the smaller number wins (if both players have the same number left, the first player wins).
step: Remove a card from the other player.
